messages:
paul: Postmortem follow-up  we need final decisions on external comms and RCA access. Items: statuspage line, 72h customer brief, and policy for sharing full RCAs vs redacted summaries.

anika: I can draft the 72h brief. Will include TL;DR, short timeline, impact metrics, and top-4 FAQs.

jon: I'll draft the statuspage blurb. Proposed: "Elevated latency for Text Gen API from 02:10-02:45 UTC due to cache eviction during a model rollout. Rollback and throttling applied. No customer data exposed. Full postmortem after redaction review."

legal: Legal: okay to state no data exposed once Security confirms. Recommend redacting orchestration commands, internal hostnames, and any customer identifiers from public copy. We'll review a redaction list.

sec-bot: Security scan complete  no exfiltration detected. Signed off on the data sentence.

prodops: ProdOps can publish statuspage once the sentence is posted to #statuspage-drafts and legal/sec sign off.

paul: Proposed sharing policy: public redacted summary + expanded customer brief for affected accounts; full internal RCA shared only on request under NDA/DPA. Thoughts?

jon: I like the tiered approach. Keeps public language tight.

anika: Action items:
- Jon: post statuspage sentence to #statuspage-drafts (due 2510001130)
- Anika: post draft 72h brief here for review by Legal/Security (due 2510001150)
- Legal: publish redaction checklist (due 2510001145)
- Eng-runtime: create guardrail ticket to prevent mass eviction during rollouts (due 2510001160)
- Sales: prepare affected-account list for targeted outreach (due 2510001165)

eng-runtime: Creating ticket RUNTIME-4100, priority P1.

sales: Will prepare the affected-account export after Anika posts the impacted list.

paul: Good. Once legal/sec sign-off on the draft we'll publish the public note and trigger enterprise outreach. React with :white_check_mark: when done or post blockers here.

anika: Drafting now, will post first pass in-thread by the due ts.

jon: Posted statuspage draft and pinged ProdOps.

legal: Redaction checklist posted: remove orchestration steps, internal hostnames/IPs, low-level runbook commands, and customer identifiers.

sec-bot: Security addendum: monitoring increased for 72h and no exfiltration found.

paul: Closing this thread for now; will re-open if blockers surface. :wave:
